metadata.title: A Scale-Critical $μ<\frac38$ Extension Principle for Spherically Symmetric Einstein-Scalar Field System
metadata.abstract: We present a new quantitative, scale-critical $C^1$ extension principle for the spherically symmetric Einstein--scalar field system. We derive estimates for solutions in the causal past of a possibly singular endpoint $\mathcal{O}$ of the center. Assume that there is no trapped surface in this region and assume that the Doppler exponent (blue shift) along each incoming null cone is uniformly bounded. We then prove that the solution can extend regularly across $\mathcal{O}$ provided the mass ratio $\mu=2m/r$ satisfies $\sup\mu<\frac38$. This improves the small-mass-ratio condition in Christodoulou's extension principle by an explicit threshold of order one. Our proof has three new ingredients. First, we derive several new uniform scale-critical pointwise estimates for the scalar field and its derivatives. Second, we obtain refined estimates in an exterior self-similar domain within the triangular causal past region. Third, we establish a family of higher-order Morawetz-type identities and identify the ranges of $\mu$, with which there are coercive spacetime estimates. The unweighted identity yields the threshold $\mu\leq\frac14$, while employing extra self-similar weight raises the threshold to $\mu<\frac38$ and provides a weighted control, which implies that the solution's BV norm along an outgoing null cone is small, so that Christodoulou's theory of bounded variation solutions gives the extension.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 对球对称 Einstein–scalar field 系统，在中心候选奇点的因果过去无 trapped surface 且入射光锥 Doppler 指数一致有界时，证明 sup(2m/r)<3/8 可保证 C1 正则延拓；利用带自相似权重的高阶 Morawetz 恒等式提升旧的小质量比阈值。
analysis.breakthrough: 给出显式量级为一的质量比阈值，并解释无权与加权估计分别对应 1/4 与 3/8。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方标题、摘要及作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读数学证明。严格不等式、无 trapped surface 与蓝移控制缺一不可；不能将该局部球对称判据概括为一般宇宙监督证明。 AI 披露以独立全文核查记录为准。
analysis.priorityReason: 按结论范围、几何关联与方法可迁移性安排阅读；严格不等式、无 trapped surface 与蓝移控制缺一不可；不能将该局部球对称判据概括为一般宇宙监督证明。
